questions.stem: Why can two parents who do not have cystic fibrosis still have a child with the condition?

options.text: Both parents could be carriers with one recessive allele each
The condition is caused by environmental factors
The child must have inherited it from a grandparent directly

questions.explanation: Cystic fibrosis is recessive, so both parents can be carriers (Cc) without showing symptoms. If both pass on their recessive allele, the child will be cc and have the condition.
